tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: dgongs gter sgrol ma'i zab tig las: slob ma rjes su gzung ba bzhugs:

'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud: slob ma rjes su gzung ba la: phyi ltar sgrub pa'i rig gtad ni: bdag mdun lhar gsal bstod pa bya: gzungs kyi bum pa tshul bzhin bsgrub: slob ma khrus byas gos gtsang gon: maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab rgyud sbyangs te: sngags kyi bum pa spyi bor bzhag: oṃ: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: rig pa'i rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i chus: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: sgrib pa'i dri ma kun byang shog: sngags mthar a bhi ṣe ka gdags: bum chus bkru zhing 'thor 'thung bya: rje btsun sgrol ma'i skur gyur bsam: mdun bskyed zhal nas bstod pa'i rgyud: yi ge bai ḍūr zhun ma'i mdangs: mar me 'bar ba lta bur 'phros: slob ma'i khar zhugs snying gar thim: byin rlabs ma lus zhugs par bsam: rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum bya: mthar ni lha bstim dmigs med bzhag: 'od gsal dgongs pa'i don ngo sprad: sku gsung thugs kyi rig gtad pas: de nyid sgom bzlas skal ldan 'gyur: sa ma ya: nang ltar sgrub pa'i dbang bskur ni: bdag mdun bum pa tshul bzhin bsgrub: bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma gzhug: sbyor ba rgyud sbyong spyi ltar la: dngos gzhi lha bskyed ye shes dbab: bum pa spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhag: hūm̐: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: bum pa'i dbang bskur bla med pas: mi bskyod ngo bor khyod dbang bskur: sngags mthar a bhi ṣiñca gdags: badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ mchan/ cod pan dngos sam phyag rgyas gtugs: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ: rdo rje dril bu g.yas g.yon sbyin: lhan cig dkrol la ming yang gdags: badz+ra dharma a bhi ṣiñca hrī: badz+ra gāṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñca ā: badz+ra nām a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: spro na tshigs gcad so sor sbyar: oṃ: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku yi dbang: deng 'dir khyod la sbyin pa yis:

rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub par shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: sku bstim sngags sbyin don ngo sprad: rgyas par 'jigs pa brgyad skyob pa'i: 'khor gyi lha dbang dag kyang bskur: zab gsal dbyer med bsgom la dbang: sa ma ya: gsang bar sgrub pa'i byin rlabs ni: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas bya: slob ma rgyud sbyang ye shes bstim: brda yi dbang bskur don ngo sprad: oṃ: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: sku yi ye shes ngo bo nyid: bum pa'i dbang bskur bla med pas: snang stong ngo bor khyod dbang bskur: sngags mthar ka la sha gdags bya: ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ ā: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: gsung gi ye shes ngo bo nyid: gsang ba'i dbang bskur bla med pas: gsal stong ngo bor khyod dbang bskur: bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca ā: hūm̐: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: thugs kyi ye shes ngo bo nyid: shes rab dbang bskur bla med pas: bde stong ngo bor khyod dbang bskur: karma mu drā a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ho: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: dbyer med ye shes ngo bo nyid: bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bla med pas: rig stong ngo bor khyod dbang bskur: dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñca ho: rjes su tshogs mchod glu gar bya: gsang ba zab mo'i snod ldan 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim:1$0000250 zhes pa'ang rje btsun sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa las mchog gyur gling pas dgongs pa'i gter kha rdol ba ltar bris pa'o// a ti gu h+ya/ 1$0000300༁ྃ: dgongs gter sgrol ma'i zab tig las: phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs: ༁ྃ: 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud: de nyid phyi ltar sgrub pa ni: 'phags ma'i bris sku bkram pa'i mdun: ci 'byor mchod pa legs par bsham: khrus byas gtsang sbra la gnas pas: nges 'byung snying rjes rgyud bskul te: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs gsag bya:

rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rje btsun 'phags ma'i skur gsal ba'i: thugs kar zla steng tāṃ ljang gu: de las 'od zer dpag yas 'phros: 'phags ma rnam 'phrul nyer gcig dang: dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin 'phro ba: mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs bsam: maṇ+ḍal la sogs mchod pas mchod: bstod pa'i rgyal po lan gnyis brjod: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya nyid: skyabs sbyin phyag rgyar gyur pa'i 'og: bdag dang bsrung bya kun tshud nas: 'jigs pa kun las dbugs dbyung mos: mchod dang bstod pa lan gsum brjod: sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs: rang dang bsrung bya'i spyi bo nas: zhugs te lus kun gang ba yis: byin rlabs ma lus zhugs par bsam: mchod cing bstod pa lan bdun mthar: mdun bskyed 'od zhu rang la thim: dbyer med nyid du byin brlabs bsam: yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa bya: lha dang rang sems dbyer med pa: chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang du gzhag: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab: shis pa brjod pas mthar dbyung ngo: spro na spyi dang bye brag gi: maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs la sogs pa: rgyas par sbyar la nyams su blang: bar chad zhi zhing dngos grub thob: sa ma ya: nang ltar sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: skyabs sems tshogs gsag sngon song nas: oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las sems kyi gdangs: tāṃ yig ljang gu mkha' la shar: de las hūm̐ gi sgra gdangs kyis: sangs rgyas byang chub brtan par byas: gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad cing: 'od zer sprin las rdo rje'i char: phab pas sa gzhi rwa ba dang: drwa ba gur dang bla rer bcas: srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che'i dbus: 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab steng: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma ni: 'dab brgyad ze'u 'brur nyi zla'i steng: tāṃ las ut+pal tāṃ gyis mtshan: de las 'od zer 'phro 'du yi:

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol mo las: rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa ni: skyabs sbyin ut+pal sngon po bsnams: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe'i phung por 'bar: dbu skra'i zur phud spyi bor bcings: lhag ma lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang: zhabs zung g.yas brkyang phyed skyil gyis: 'od zer sna lnga'i klong na 'gying: snang stong zung 'jug thugs srog tāṃ: de las gnyis pa phyogs mtshams 'phros: 'gro rnams gnas skabs mthar thug gi: phyi nang 'jigs brgyad zhi bar mdzad: rje btsun 'phags ma'i go 'phang bkod: tshur 'dus 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng: pad zla'i gdan la 'khod pa las: shar nas brtsam ste g.yas skor du: seng ge'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma mthing: mchog sbyin ut+pal rdo rje bsnams: glang chen 'jigs skyob sgrol ma ser: mchog sbyin ut+pal lcags kyu bsnams: me yi 'jigs skyob sgrol ma dkar: mchog sbyin ut+pal chu shel bsnams: sbrul gyi 'jigs skyob sgrol ma ljang: mchog sbyin ut+pal sman mchog bsnams: chom rkun 'jigs skyob sgrol ma dkar: mchog sbyin ut+pal mda' gzhu bsnams: lcags sgrog 'jigs skyob sgrol ma ljang: mchog sbyin ut+pal ral gri bsnams: rgya mtsho'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma dmar: mchog sbyin ut+pal me shel bsnams: sha za'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma nag: mchog sbyin ut+pal mdung thung bsnams: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso mo'i tshul: khyams la mchod pa'i lha mo dang: sgo bzhir phyag rgya bzhi'i lha mo: rang rang rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: kun kyang zab gsal gnyis med kyi: ye shes sgyu ma'i skur shar ba'i: gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan: de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas: rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa: drangs te gnyis su med par bsam: tāṃ: chos sku mkha' ltar rnam dag kyang: longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku: mkha' las nyi gsal 'od bzhin du:

dmigs med thugs rjes gnas 'dir gshegs: oṃ ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi: badz+ra sa mā dza: oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dza: oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya ho: dgug gzhug bcing mnyes dbyer med bya: slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs nas: ye shes bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: sku gang sgrib dag rigs kyi bdag: 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan bsam: oṃ pad+ma dha ra a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥhūm̐ trāṃ oṃ ā: ho: bde bar gshegs so sems ma'i gtso: tshur gshegs dam ye dbyer med par: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: dz+nyā na sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu: na mo: rmad byung thugs bskyed dam bcas nas: 'gro ba sgrol ba'i phrin las kyis: rgyal kun byang chub spyod pa mchog: yongs su rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na mā mi: oṃ: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni: sgeg sogs lha mos nam mkha' gang: kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las: byung ba'i ye shes rol mos mchod: oṃ badz+ra lā s+yai hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra mā l+yai trāṃ: oṃ badz+ra gīrtī hrī: oṃ badz+ra nīrtī ā: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrī: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe ā: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: bstod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud kyis bstod: de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni: gtso mo'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng: tāṃ mthar yi ge bcu pas bskor: gsal zhing 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul las: sku dang sngags phreng 'od zer tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i spro bsdu yis: sangs rgyas mdzad pa yongs su bsgrubs: 'gro kun 'phags ma'i go 'phang bkod: tshur 'dus tāṃ la thim pa yis: dngos grub ye shes dbang bsgyur zhing: phyag rgya'i ye shes thob par bsam: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā: bar med bzla zhing lha dang sngags: 'od zer spro bsdur sems 'dzin cing: shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i dbyings:

rang bzhin yongs shes ngang du gzhag: 'phags ma'i ting 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur: slar yang thugs nas 'od 'phros pas: 'khor gyi sgrol ma'i thugs rgyud bskul: 'gro rnams phyi nang 'jigs pa bsal: 'dod rgu'i dngos grub bstsal bar bsam: na mo rat+na tra yā ya: na ma ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra ya: bo dhi satwā ya: ma hā satwa ya: ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya: tad+ya thā: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba duṣ+ṭān: pra duṣ+ṭān: ma ma kṛ te: dzaṃ bha ya: s+t+waṃ bha ya: mo ha ya: bh+n+bha ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: sarba duṣ+ṭān s+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swā hā: rtsa sngags 'bum phrag bcu dang ni: las sngags khri phrag bzhi bzlas 'grub: thun mtshams mdun bskyed mchod pa dang: bdag nyid 'jug pa'i dbang blang sogs: spros la dga' bas ji bzhin spyad: thun mthar mchod bstod dngos grub blang: nongs pa bshags shing ye shes gshegs: dam tshig 'od gsal dbyings su bsdu: slar yang 'phags ma'i nga rgyal gyis: bsngo smon shis brjod rgya cher bya: bdun phrag gsum du brtson pas kyang: bar chad zhi zhing legs tshogs rgyas: rtse gcig nyams blangs zab gsal gnyis: dbyer med ye shes 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsang ba ltar du sgrub pa ni: skyabs sems tshogs gsag bgegs bskrad cing: srung 'khor byin dbab mchod rdzas brlab: de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum las: rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed: a: stong pa de bzhin nyid kyi ngang: snying rje chen por kun tu snang: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i: rgyu yi yi ge tāṃ ljang gu: mkha' las 'ja' tshon bzhin du snang: de las ye shes me rlung chus: snod bcud bag chags bsregs gtor bkrus: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: mi phyed rdo rje'i srung 'khor dbus: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab steng: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal med khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus pad zla'i gdan gyi steng:

nyi zla kha sbyor dbus su tāṃ: de las ut+pal tāṃ gyis mtshan: yongs gyur bdag nyid skad cig gis: dam tshig sgrol ma sku mdog ljang: zhi 'dzum chags pa'i nyams kyis sgeg: dbu skra gnag snum spyi bor bcings: rtse mor yid bzhin nor bus brgyan: lhag ma sil bu lcang lor 'phyang: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa ni: skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas ut+pal bsnams: zhabs zung g.yas brkyang rol pas 'gying: rang 'od rdo rje rta mchog dpal: ljang gsal ral gri dril bu 'dzin: cung zad khro zhing chags pa'i nyams: yab yum mnyam sbyor gzi brjid 'bar: dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: snyoms par zhugs pa'i mkha' gsang nas: byang sems sa bon 'phro 'du las: rigs bzhi phrin las sgo ma bcas: snang stong zung 'jug chen por bskyed: tāṃ: stong pa shin tu yod med 'od gsal dbyings: nam mkha' bzhin las thugs rje'i dam tshig gis: ye shes sgyu ma'i yum gyur rje btsun ma: rigs kyi 'khor lor bcas te gnas 'dir gshegs: phyi nang 'jigs dang sdug bsngal ma lus sol: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i byin chen phob: lus ngag yid la mchog gi dbang bzhi skur: las dang ye shes dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tā ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi: badz+ra dz+nyā na dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a la la ho: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: mchod cing bstod pa ci rigs bya: thugs kar ye shes sems ma ni: phag mo mthing nag gri thod 'dzin: de yi thugs kar nyi zla'i sbubs: ting 'dzin sems dpa' tāṃ ljang gu: mtha' skor rdo rje'i sngags kyis mtshan: gsal zhing 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: sgrib gnyis bag chags kun sbyangs bsam: oṃ tā re hūm̐ phaṭa: sgrib sbyong sku yi bzlas pa 'o: sngags las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa mchod: byin rlabs dngos grub ye shes kun: tshur 'dus bdag thim gnyis med bsam:

oṃ tā re swā hā: byin rlabs gsung gi bzlas pa 'o: thugs srog nā da las byung ba'i: sngags phreng mgal me bzhin du 'khor: yab yum bde chen ye shes bskyed: mi 'gyur mchog dngos 'grub par bsam: oṃ tā re tāṃ hūm̐: bde chen thugs kyi bzlas pa 'o: rang dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs las: lha sngags phyag mtshan 'od zer tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba'i spro bsdu yis: sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsgrubs par bsam: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re badz+ra bha ra hi baṃ swā hā: yon tan yongs rdzogs bzlas pa 'o: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gnas bzhi nas: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser 'phros: 'jigs pa kun las dbugs dbyung zhing: rnam bzhi'i phrin las yongs rdzogs bsam: las sbyor gzungs kyi rig pa bzla: phrin las mthar dbyung bzlas pa 'o: de la sku gsung thugs bzlas pa: 'bum phrag re ni grangs kyi tshad: yon tan yongs rdzogs 'bum phrag bzhi: phrin las rig pa khri bzhi bzlas: nus pa 'phags ma nyid dang mtshungs: thun mthar mchod cing khyad par du: rdo rje'i rgyud kyis gzhi bstod bya: thabs shes rdzas la bdud rtsis bran: byin gyis brlabs shing tshogs mchod 'bul: dus dang rgyun gyi dngos grub gsol: oṃ: shin tu rnam dag 'od gsal dkyil: rig pa ye shes 'khor lo'i tshul: tshogs mchog dam tshig sgrol ma'i lha: rtse gcig bsnyen cing bsgrubs lags na: sngon tshe thugs bskyed dam bcas ltar: mi 'gyur mi shigs 'od gsal rtsal: rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las mchog gi dngos grub stsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sarba sid+dhi pha la ho: gzhan yang mchod bstod nongs bshags sogs: rjes kyi las rim tshul bzhin bya: thun mong las tshogs gzhan du zab: khyad par myong grol rdzas sbyor ni: 'bras bu lnga

a bar skyur gsum dzā ti li shi/ dang dwangs ma lnga: cong zhi brag zhun gla rtsi dbang lag dngul chu dul ma/ rdzas lnga rtag ngu gsum dang cu gang sin+dhu ra/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: lnga tshan nyer lnga tshul bzhin sbyar: ut+pal sngon pos bungs bskyed la: mchog gi rdzas gdung ring bsrel skye bdun sogs/ bcas ril bur dril: bhan+dha'i snod blugs dkyil 'khor bskyed: bzlas pa'i dmigs pa 'di ltar sbyar: thugs ka'i ye shes sems ma ni: rdo rje phag mo'i thugs ka nas: mi g.yo khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil: ljang sngon lcags kyu bum pa 'dzin: nam mkhar gang bar rab spros pas: brtan g.yo srid zhi'i khams kun khyab: las dang ye shes dngos grub kun: lcags kyus bkug cing bum par bskyil: bdud rtsi'i bcud du 'khyil ba yis: lha tshogs rnams kyi spyi bo nas: dbang bskur sku yi nang kun khengs: dwangs ma thugs srog sa bon dang: dbyer med nyid du 'dres pa yis: 'khor 'das bcud dang dge mtshan kun: thig le gcig tu rdzogs par bsam: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī sarba sid+dhi swā hā: zhag gsum thun du bcad la bzlas: thun mtshams tshogs mchod bgegs bsal zhing: byin chen dbab dang brtan par bya: 'od dang sgra dang dri bzang dang: 'phel dang g.yo na grub pa'i rtags: mthong bas lus sems sdug bsngal zhi: 'chang na srung ba kun gyi mchog: myong bas nad gdon sdig sgrib 'dag: yun du bsten na 'chi med cing: bde chen rab 'bar mkha' spyod 'grub: mchog gi las kyi sbyor ba ni: legs so gsum gyi don khrid bskyang: lhan skyes don gyi 'phags ma yi: go 'phang tshe 'dir 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: 1$0000250zhes pa'ang rje btsun sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa las mchog gyur gling pas dgongs pa'i gter kha rdol ba ltar bris pa'o// a ti gu h+ya/1$0000300 ༁ྃ:

dgongs gter sgrol ma'i zab tig las: legs so gsum gyi don khrid bzhugs: ༁ྃ: 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud: de yi don khrid rim pa ni: legs so gsum gyi man ngag ste: legs so legs so legs so zhes: rdo rje mi shigs nā da'i rgyud: brjod med brjod pa kun gyi gzhi: gdul bya'i bsam pa bzhin du snang: legs so dang po lha mi dang: nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa'i bcud: dad dang nges 'byung rnam dag ste: thog mar dge ba lam stegs khrid: legs so gnyis pa theg chen bcud: byams dang snying rje la brten nas: lhag bsam rnam dag bskyed pa ste: bar du dge ba dngos gzhi'i khrid: legs so tha ma gsang sngags bcud: bskyed dang rdzogs pa la brten nas: ye shes rnam dag bskyed pa ste: tha mar dge ba rjes kyi khrid: de rnams ji bzhin nyams blang phyir: dbang thob gdams ngag gnad rig cing: dam tshig sdom pa yongs dag pas: dben pa'i gnas su bya ba btang: lus gnad bsrangs la rlung ro 'bud: dran pa mngon du bzhag byas te: bla ma rje btsun sgrol mar bskyed: rtse gcig gsol btab mos gus bskyed: thugs yid bsres la mnyam par gzhag: de nas nyams len rim pa ni: dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig sla dang: ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dran: las 'bras bslu med yid ches pas: skyabs gnas kun 'dus rje btsun mar: rtse gcig skyabs gsol bslab bya bsrung: mtho ris gsum yang 'gyur ba dang: 'du byed sdug bsngal kho na'i phyir: khams gsum me 'obs ltar mthong ba'i: nges 'byung drag pos thar lam bsgrub: de ni sngon 'gro'i khrid rim mo: sdug bsngal can gyi 'khor ba pa: de kun bdag gi drin can ma: de phyir de rnams thams cad la: byams dang snying rjes kun bslangs te: bdag gi bde dge gzhan la gtong: sdug bsngal kun 'byung rang la blang: thog mar rtsa ba'i ma nas gzung: mkha' khyab kun la blo 'byongs nas: de kun bde la 'god pa dang:
